title: A no-named-arguments contract rejects an otherwise executable named call

ground_truth.statement: The @no-named-arguments policy disallows named calls to the annotated function. PHP itself permits them, as the runtime control establishes. This is a measured optional API policy, not a claim of runtime unsafety.

provenance.note: Removed unrelated UnusedParam suppression, used both arguments, retained the unprefixed policy tag.

notes: Positional call line 6 is the control. Tool silence remains a measured policy difference rather than being relabelled unsupported. Shares the constructor annotation's criterion: function versus constructor calls are variants of the same optional no-named-arguments policy, not independent coverage.
